issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness
issues.problem: tui-demo.sh uses read -r twice; subprocess.run blocks 30s then TimeoutExpired uncaught in run_audit.py
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — catch TimeoutExpired; record fail row
[ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — LI_TUI_HARNESS=1 or stdin pipe path
[ ] Test: run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture records fail without crash
[ ] Acceptance: proactive audit writes complete ui-audit.json

issues.title: [ui-audit] TUI harness lacks stdout frame capture and baseline diff
issues.problem: tui adapter pass/fail only checks exit code; no stdout capture, insta/VHS baseline, or pixel_diff for terminal frames
evidence: tui-gen-fixture pass leaves artifacts: [] until manual capture
pixel_diff.max_ratio 0.0 is adapter default not measured
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — write stdout to captures/{target_id}.txt
[ ] File: ux-harness/baselines/tui/ — seed text baselines for fixtures
[ ] Acceptance: baseline_status fail on frame drift

issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-demo.sh UTF-8 em dash mojibake in harness captures
issues.problem: Em dash in fixture title renders as M-bM-^@M-^T in cat -v capture when locale/encoding not UTF-8
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — env LANG=C.UTF-8 for fixture subprocess
[ ] Or File: tui-demo.sh — ASCII hyphen in title for CI captures
[ ] Test: capture file contains readable em dash or ASCII dash consistently
